study.question: Can the compact mean residual improve its purchase trade-off by independently choosing pooling for item fields and the historical action embedding? Observed limitation: g1-r0009-compact_mean scores 0.8307402933986681 versus compact_din 0.8304973270842566, with AUC deltas click +0.0004219764, cart +0.0013879165, fav +0.0004489817, buy -0.0012870093. Against g0 its buy AUC drops 0.0014604766 despite macro gain +0.0005420721. These are observed single-seed validation results, not new measurements.
study.hypothesis: The unweighted residual may supply broad item context suppressed by target-local DIN weighting, while unweighted historical action composition may partly explain the purchase ranking trade-off. Choosing item mean with DIN-weighted action could retain the three-task benefit and recover purchase utility at unchanged active capacity. The reverse hybrid and both existing endpoints form a factorial test of this directional explanation. Relative scale and optimization remain alternative explanations; no new mechanism or novelty is established in advance.

nearest_work.difference: Archived exact-version primary text lines 250-277 describes target-local weighted sum pooling without softmax normalization. We retain that inherited path and independently replace its item/action coordinates only inside an additional normalized low-rank residual. Mean pooling and field-specific source selection are not claimed as new methods.

Pinned benchmark ESTBlocks.forward lines 198-216 alternates cross-attention and mixed FFN updates for sequence/non-sequence tokens. This proposal leaves g0 interaction unchanged and switches only a terminal summary source, with no new heterogeneous FFN. Original EST paper detail is not audited, so novelty relative to it remains unverified.

Pinned benchmark HyFormerBlock.forward lines 221-243 repeatedly encodes sequences, decodes queries and boosts non-sequential tokens. The compact residual has no active query decoder or evolving sequence. Original-paper detail is unavailable in this authorized archive; no priority or reproduction claim.

Only the author README is available; it warns that its behavior data has category, brand and behavior type but no item. Current histories contain prior advertisement IDs and six item fields. Do not transfer an item-sequence claim or assert a DMR mechanism comparison from this README.

Trajectory review: g1-r0006-hybrid_adaptive (0.83014755) and hybrid_uniform (0.83017069) did not beat g0; hybrid_none (0.83045060) did. Rotated prior (0.82996332) was worse. In g1-r0007 adaptive state reads (0.83069404) did not beat uniform state reads (0.83071774), and adding the terminal prior lowered both. These negative branches oppose an adaptive-prior utility claim on this representation.

Further controls: g1-r0008-identity_attention (0.83054415) and din_reparameterization (0.83049733) did not beat mean_residual (0.83074029). g1-r0008-incumbent_replay exactly repeated 0.83071774; g1-r0009 compact_mean reproduced mean_residual score at 512.95 versus 997.95 wall seconds. Identical-seed replay is reproducibility evidence, not independent mechanism support. No failed execution is present in the authorized trajectory supplied here; abandoned negative variants remain part of the evidence.
study.proposed_difference: Inside TerminalRetrieval, construct both the masked uniform mean and inherited DIN sum, then concatenate either mean item coordinates with DIN action coordinates (item_mean_action_din) or DIN item coordinates with mean action coordinates (item_din_action_mean). Feed this same-width tensor through the unchanged active residual. Existing uniform and DIN modes remain available for host preflight endpoint equivalence, with their committed results reused rather than paying for duplicate same-seed training. No new embedding, parameter, token, task routing, feature, label, timestamp, training recipe or loss is introduced.
predictions: Directional prediction: Y_MD (item_mean_action_din) exceeds Y_MM in validation macro AUC and improves purchase AUC while preserving most click/cart/fav benefit. Selection nevertheless uses equal-weight macro AUC, with the frozen Logloss/parameter/ID tie-breakers and no task veto.
If broad item context is useful, Y_MD-Y_DD and Y_MM-Y_DM are both positive for macro AUC, with effects strongest on click/cart/fav; opposite signs indicate dependence on action pooling.

A nonzero factorial interaction indicates dependence between source choices in this trained implementation; it is not proof of an item-feedback binding mechanism. Report all four task AUC and Logloss contrasts, even when they disagree with macro selection.

All cells have the same active parameter declarations and initialization; expected total/dense counts are 33,042,117 / 1,248,901. New candidate cost should be near compact_mean (512.95 wall seconds, 463.95 train seconds, 39.45 validation inference seconds, 8,446,263,808 peak GPU bytes), but those predictions require host measurement.

Host preflight should find uniform and DIN endpoint functions/active initial tensors consistent with the corresponding archived modules; padded history IDs and current target action must not affect predictions. The added residual must be exactly zero for empty histories, including after training.
falsifiers: If neither mixed candidate exceeds Y_MM, the proposed mixed-source performance extension fails at this seed, even if one factorial effect is informative. Keep the incumbent and do not declare compatibility from the test merely completing.
If Y_MD does not recover purchase AUC or its item effects are nonpositive at both action settings, the directional item-context/action-dilution explanation lacks support for this implementation.

If the active-capacity DIN replacement matches the mean/hybrid under paired repetitions, complementary information is not established; capacity, optimization or validation noise remain viable explanations.

Endpoint numerical mismatch beyond host-established tolerance, changed active initialization/RNG, nonfinite outputs/gradients, parameter mismatch, padding sensitivity or target-action sensitivity invalidates the intended matched comparison. Retain failure costs and repair through the authorized interface; do not reinterpret it as scientific counterevidence.

Disappearance or reversal of an apparent advantage on paired new seeds prevents repeated-support claims. No seed confidence interval or user-cluster significance is claimed from the current single-seed endpoints.
alternative_explanations: One seed and adaptive prior model selection; observed differences are preliminary and have no significance interval.

cost_plan.attribution_reserve: The two prospective mixed-source candidates cost about 1100 seconds total; the committed compact_mean and compact_din provide the other two factorial cells at identical frozen protocol/seed and equal active capacity. Reserve about 200 seconds inside unallocated headroom for endpoint numerical, initialization, padding/current-action invariance and gradient preflight; do not launch duplicate full-data same-seed endpoint training merely for replay. cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Protect approximately 3200 seconds for validation-only attribution/repetition after candidate choice and suite freeze. Target two additional paired seeds for selected model, closest control and g0 (six jobs, around 3000-3150 seconds), using host-authorized seed execution without editing the frozen training recipe. The weaker frozen g1 source and DIN baseline may remain single-seed comparisons. If the host phase does not expose repetition or time is insufficient, record omitted jobs and keep conclusions preliminary. No withheld split, test labels or closed archive is requested.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Use actual charged remaining time before each admitted job. Stop new exploration if estimated complete-unit cost plus protected assessment reserve and necessary preflight cannot fit; never raise the 1208.5413760878146 per-trial cap or campaign deadline. If the first mixed candidate consumes the cap, reassess admission of the second and explicitly report any incomplete factorial. Count failures and unknown execution state; do not automatically duplicate a possibly completed run. Prefer freezing the best supported existing model over spending the reserve on further search. Stop at a hard limit regardless of scientific outcome.
